display_name: Repaired CAD · cover support · reset variations

00_loose.description: All five pickup pieces loose; retain corrected tangent and nearest-grasp-end layout.
00_loose.boundary_review: Sampled native boundaries and registration pass; dynamics and loaded grasps remain unqualified

01_cover_pickup.description: Left has just picked up the side cover by its two opposed exterior side walls near the flange end. Right remains open nearby.
01_cover_pickup.boundary_review: Sampled native boundaries and registration pass; dynamics and loaded grasps remain unqualified

03_cover_aligned.description: Left holds the cover above the base with the slide features aligned, maintaining the exterior-wall pinch. Right remains open nearby.
03_cover_aligned.boundary_review: Sampled native boundaries and registration pass; dynamics and loaded grasps remain unqualified

04_cover_entry.description: Cover has just entered its slide; left maintains the exterior-wall pinch and right remains open nearby.
04_cover_entry.boundary_review: Sampled native boundaries and registration pass; dynamics and loaded grasps remain unqualified

05_cover_near.description: Cover is almost seated with a short final slide remaining; maintain the exterior-wall pinch.
05_cover_near.boundary_review: Sampled native boundaries and registration pass; dynamics and loaded grasps remain unqualified

07_connector_pickup.description: Right holds the connector by its opposed socket side faces as in IMG_1617. Left is open and naturally withdrawn from the preceding cover-placement pose.
07_connector_pickup.boundary_review: Sampled native boundaries and registration pass; dynamics and loaded grasps remain unqualified

08_connector_aligned.description: Right holds the connector by its socket side faces, horizontally aligned with the side of the base. Left remains open in its post-cover retreat pose.
08_connector_aligned.boundary_review: Sampled native boundaries and registration pass; dynamics and loaded grasps remain unqualified

09_connector_entry.description: Right starts sliding the connector onto the base while maintaining the socket-side grasp. Left stays open and withdrawn from the insertion corridor.
09_connector_entry.boundary_review: Sampled native boundaries and registration pass; dynamics and loaded grasps remain unqualified

10_connector_near.description: Connector is almost seated with a short horizontal push remaining. Right maintains its socket-side grasp; left stays open nearby.
10_connector_near.boundary_review: Sampled native boundaries and registration pass; dynamics and loaded grasps remain unqualified

12_pin_pickup.description: Left has picked up the pin by its larger upper grip cylinder. The thin shaft remains clear; right keeps holding the connector.
12_pin_pickup.boundary_review: Sampled native boundaries and registration pass; dynamics and loaded grasps remain unqualified

13_pin_aligned.description: Left pinches the larger upper cylinder with the thin shaft pointing down above the pivot hole. Right keeps holding the connector.
13_pin_aligned.boundary_review: Sampled native boundaries and registration pass; dynamics and loaded grasps remain unqualified

14_pin_half.description: Pin shaft is partially inserted, approximately halfway in the authored reference. Left holds the larger upper cylinder and right holds the connector; completion remains unearned.
14_pin_half.boundary_review: Sampled native boundaries and registration pass; dynamics and loaded grasps remain unqualified

15_pin_near.description: Pin is nearly seated with a short final insertion remaining. Left holds its larger upper cylinder; right retains the connector hold.
15_pin_near.boundary_review: Sampled native boundaries and registration pass; dynamics and loaded grasps remain unqualified

17_left_support.description: Left releases the pin and acquires the photo-matched base/connector support before right lets go. Both assembly-support holds coexist during this transition. Left grips the installed base side cover by its opposed exterior side walls.

grasp_calibration.qualification: Measured native bilateral precontact centroid registration, not zeroed IK residual; loaded retention unqualified

left.qualification: Two-sided native finger geometry checked; loaded retention remains separately tested

17_left_support.boundary_review: Sampled native boundaries and registration pass; dynamics and loaded grasps remain unqualified

18_upper_floor_grasp.description: Right pinches opposing exposed faces of the black servo 2 case as in IMG_1612 while the rest of the link stays on the table. Preserve the approved component orientation. Left holds the base/connector assembly. Left grips the installed base side cover by its opposed exterior side walls.

grasp_calibration.qualification: Measured native bilateral precontact centroid registration, not zeroed IK residual; loaded retention unqualified

left.qualification: Two-sided native finger geometry checked; loaded retention remains separately tested

18_upper_floor_grasp.boundary_review: Sampled native boundaries and registration pass; dynamics and loaded grasps remain unqualified

20_upper_transport.description: Right transports the upper-arm module with a black servo 2 case grasp. Left retains its base/connector support. Left grips the installed base side cover by its opposed exterior side walls.

grasp_calibration.qualification: Measured native bilateral precontact centroid registration, not zeroed IK residual; loaded retention unqualified

left.qualification: Two-sided native finger geometry checked; loaded retention remains separately tested

20_upper_transport.boundary_review: Sampled native boundaries and registration pass; dynamics and loaded grasps remain unqualified

21_upper_far_side.description: The opposite non-servo end rests on the receiver edge as in IMG_1611, forming the supported triangle. Right holds the black servo 2 case above its pocket, with the servo directed straight down into that pocket. Left holds the base/connector assembly. Left grips the installed base side cover by its opposed exterior side walls.

grasp_calibration.qualification: Measured native bilateral precontact centroid registration, not zeroed IK residual; loaded retention unqualified

left.qualification: Two-sided native finger geometry checked; loaded retention remains separately tested

22_upper_half.description: Servo 2 is partly inserted while the opposite end remains resting on the receiver edge. Right holds the black case and keeps it aligned with the pocket; left retains base/connector support. Left grips the installed base side cover by its opposed exterior side walls.

grasp_calibration.qualification: Measured native bilateral precontact centroid registration, not zeroed IK residual; loaded retention unqualified

left.qualification: Two-sided native finger geometry checked; loaded retention remains separately tested

23_upper_near.description: Servo 2 is almost seated with a small final insertion remaining. The opposite end stays on the receiver edge and the case remains pocket-aligned; left keeps supporting the base/connector assembly. Left grips the installed base side cover by its opposed exterior side walls.

grasp_calibration.qualification: Measured native bilateral precontact centroid registration, not zeroed IK residual; loaded retention unqualified

left.qualification: Two-sided native finger geometry checked; loaded retention remains separately tested

25_right_support.description: Right holds the installed upper-arm piece with both fingers clear of the assembly, as in IMG_1609. Left retains its base/connector support until the right support is established. Keep the next insertion corridor open. Left grips the installed base side cover by its opposed exterior side walls.

grasp_calibration.qualification: Measured native bilateral precontact centroid registration, not zeroed IK residual; loaded retention unqualified

left.qualification: Two-sided native finger geometry checked; loaded retention remains separately tested

26_final_floor_grasp.description: Left pinches the exposed black servo 3 case on the final two-servo module while the module is on the table, using the wrist orientation shown in IMG_1609. Right holds the installed upper arm.
26_final_floor_grasp.photo_review_note: Right support uses an inverted wrist to keep the final insertion corridor clear; wrist roll differs from the photos.

28_final_transport.description: Left transports the final module with a black servo 3 case grasp. Right maintains the installed upper-arm support.
28_final_transport.photo_review_note: Right support uses an inverted wrist to keep the final insertion corridor clear; wrist roll differs from the photos.

29_final_far_side.description: The opposite end rests on the installed upper arm as in IMG_1608. Left holds the black servo 3 case aligned with the receiving pocket in the tilted upper-arm frame. Right keeps holding the installed upper arm.
29_final_far_side.photo_review_note: Right support uses an inverted wrist to keep the final insertion corridor clear; wrist roll differs from the photos.

30_final_half.description: Servo 3 is partly inserted along the tilted receiving pocket. The opposite end stays supported on the upper arm; left holds the black case and right maintains upper-arm support.
30_final_half.photo_review_note: Right support uses an inverted wrist to keep the final insertion corridor clear; wrist roll differs from the photos.

31_final_near.description: Servo 3 is nearly seated with a small final insertion remaining along the tilted pocket. Keep its opposite end resting on the upper arm and preserve right-arm support.
31_final_near.photo_review_note: Right support uses an inverted wrist to keep the final insertion corridor clear; wrist roll differs from the photos.
